fact: The Centre de recherche en sciences humaines (CRESH) in Kinshasa held a conference on digital technology and development in the Congolese context, including digital sovereignty, on 26 July 2024.

The Universite panafricaine de gouvernance et innovations held a colloquium on AI with the Observatoire de gouvernance research centre and the University of Kinshasa, and it recommended a national digital policy.

The ACP reports that the CES-UDPS (the UDPS scientific elite corps) held a scientific morning in Kinshasa on valuing Congolese data for locally adapted AI solutions, with Prof. Elysee Ilunga of ISTA speaking.
